track_strategy: Re-engage only people who previously completed a LUCI demo or seriously pursued one. The five-email ladder moves from recognition and selective access, to concrete product changes, to pure logistics, then splits into a human attendee follow-up and an on-demand no-show path. The history is acknowledged without implying current use or customer status. New LUCI remains in beta, greater property-team control always keeps the LUCI partnership visible, and the event is consistently a private preview rather than a sales demo.
